children.default: You talk to the people who design and run your technology, not to a salesperson.

default.point_body: Zero time difference with New York. Standups, incidents, and calls happen inside your working day — not the morning after.
Native-level English and Spanish across the team. Requirements, documentation, and support without translation loss.

Monitoring, tested backups, managed security, and real process — run by a CTO who has led technology for operations of 1,000+ people, including PCI DSS compliance and a SOC 2 program end to end. The same standard, at a fraction of what the market charges for it.
You work directly with the founders who design and operate your systems. No juniors learning on your dime, no account managers in between.
